test_a/learned.method: regex scan of spec.json+spec.md for each do-not theme, every hit read in context
test_a/learned.notes: All hits are compliance statements: flush leaf with no architrave (do-not 0); asymmetric corner piers (1); 'no mantel', plain brick slab (2); 'no vertical joints drawn' (3); flat ceiling (4); hearth on the north wall treated as the internal service wall with passage along its front (5).

test_b/learned.method: regex scan of spec.json+spec.md for each do-not theme, every hit read in context
test_b/learned.notes: No hearth in this brief. Flush door with concealed frame (0); south wall deliberately not bilaterally symmetrical (1); no applied ornament, no curved mouldings (2); 'flush-struck vertical joints' so only the coursing reads (3).

test_c/learned.method: regex scan of spec.json+spec.md for each do-not theme, every hit read in context
test_c/learned.notes: Flush doors, no architraves (0); window groups on different centrelines, fireplace face symmetrical only about its own centre (1); 'no mantel', plain cast stone with no mouldings (2); flush-tooled vertical joints (3); flat ceiling, no vault (4); hearth core on the internal north wall at the zone junction, not an exterior wall (5).

note: Baseline designs are not subject to the do-not list (PRD §5.4 check 7 applies it to the learned arm only).
